verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents custom quotas that cap the amount of data processed per day across projects and users, which can stop runaway on-demand query spend. Community users also point to dry-run and pre-run byte estimates for avoiding surprise charges. The $14,000 surprise bill shows these guards are opt-in rather than default, but it does not contradict the quota feature itself. missing for 10: budget alerts or billing-triggered stops, per-query cost caps, auto-suspend or idle-shutdown controls for reserved slot capacity, and independent corroboration that quotas actually halt overnight runaway spend.
